name: National Capital District (Papua New Guinea)
description: A yellow field charged at the centre with a black roundel bearing a lakatoi sailing canoe and the words 'National Capital District Commission — NCDC'.
history: The flag of the National Capital District Commission, which governs Port Moresby, replaced an earlier version lettered 'City of Port Moresby'. No adoption date has been published.

features.role: lakatoi, the Motu trading canoe, within a lettered ring
features.symbolism: the Motu people of the Port Moresby area
